digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Wednesday, October 14 has seven live meetings, one protected work block, 17 carried-over actions, and 11 urgent items. The day turns on confirming Denver's Amazon Connect go-live after a successful Direct to Agent test, while closing the voicemail, PTO, and offboarding operating rules before Thursday's Houston and Austin wave. At 1:30 PM, lead the Attorney Review routing decision in Jhara's absence, then protect time for five downward reviews due tomorrow and a critical Supabase row-level-security finding. Dashboard completion state has not refreshed since October 8, so some carry-over work may already be complete.

items.detail: Direct to Agent, transfers, direct dialing, and consent messaging passed Tuesday. Confirm the brief Denver retest and go-live this morning, then assign decisions for personal voicemail access, manager coverage after offboarding, and PTO call redirection before Houston and Austin launch Thursday.
